verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop app running a coding agent locally on your own projects. That agent can work autonomously when full permissions are enabled. It can branch, use worktrees, commit, push and open pull requests for review, which covers the hand-off-for-review part of the story. Nothing shows it running as a cloud agent, running tests, or producing demos. Missing for 10: cloud/remote agent execution, evidence of autonomous test runs, demo artifacts (screenshots/video/live preview) for review, independent corroboration.
